newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney names co-heads of banking unit.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney names co-heads of banking unit.

text.p: Smith Barney said it named two co-heads of its investment banking division to replace Robert Lessin, who will become a senior adviser to Chairman James Dimon.

The company said it named William Mills and James Boshart as co-heads of the division, which had $864 million in revenues for the nine months ended September 30, compared with $585 million a year ago. Smith Barney, a unit of the Travelers Group, had revenue of $4.7 million for the period, compared with $3.95 billion a year ago.
Mills had been chief operating officer of the investment banking division, while Boshart had been head of Smith Barney's capital markets division, Smith Barney said.
Lessin will assist the company with client development and growth strategies in his new role, the company added.
A Smith Barney spokesman described Lessin's move as voluntary and said of the investment banking unit, "It's become such a big business now, more than one person have to run it."
